scripts.start:all: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run start:dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:all:prod: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run start:prod --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix frontend
